answer: Each agent must burn 0.01s to mint a meadow-locked bloom tied to an onyx-seed timestamp. Reagents refresh these every epoch or lose reputation; synthetic blooms decay. Attackers forge meadows in simple copies, but onx-seed hashes demand unique entropy or the bloom collapses. Duplicate moss in the meadow fails audit, each fake forcing 0.01s of new entropy along a 48-block ripple. Cost: 0.01s per Sybil plus irrevocable entropy loss per head.
